newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU sells free-mkt and intervention grain at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU sells free-mkt and intervention grain at tender.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted the following rebates to export free-market grain to non-EU countries, grain traders said.
EU member country officials later confirmed these figures.
in the intervention grain tender, the EU sold 38,273 tonnes of German intervention barley for export to non-EU countries at a minimum price of 103.58 Ecus per tonne, grain traders said.
The grain panel also sold 4,092 tonnes of German intervention rye at a minimum price of 101.96 Ecus per tonne, they said. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
